stories.title: The DOJ is investigating a16z. What does this mean for venture capital?
stories.simple_summary: The U.S. Department of Justice is investigating a major investment company (Andreessen Horowitz) because two of its leaders sit on the boards of companies that compete with each other, which could be unfair.
stories.why_it_matters: This mostly matters to investors and large companies — nothing you need to act on, though it could affect how investment firms operate in the future.

stories.title: Starcloud raises $250 million for orbital data centers as launch options dry up
stories.simple_summary: A company called Starcloud raised $250 million to build computer data centers in space to store and process information.
stories.why_it_matters: This mostly matters to investors and large tech companies — it has no impact on ordinary people or small businesses right now.

stories.title: Major YouTube creators are facing backlash for accepting AI money
stories.simple_summary: Popular video creators on YouTube were paid by an AI video-making company to promote their software, and some people are criticizing them for taking the money.
stories.why_it_matters: It's a reminder to be skeptical when creators promote products, especially AI tools — they may have been paid to do so.

stories.title: US corporate AI debt surge tests investor limits as fatigue emerges
stories.simple_summary: Large companies are spending heavily on AI projects, and some investors are becoming concerned about whether this spending will actually pay off.
stories.why_it_matters: This is mainly a story about stock market investors — nothing directly affecting small business owners right now.

stories.title: Pope Leo XIV: In age of AI, the family is the first school of humanity
stories.simple_summary: The Pope commented that families remain important for teaching values even in an age of artificial intelligence.
stories.why_it_matters: This is a religious and cultural statement, not an AI news story that affects how you use technology.

stories.title: Billionaire Investor Stanley Druckenmiller Just Sold Intel and Micron, and Piled Into 2 Artificial Intelligence (AI) Stocks That Are Betting Big on Robotics
stories.simple_summary: A wealthy investor sold shares in computer memory companies and bought shares in AI companies instead, betting AI will grow more than memory chips.
stories.why_it_matters: This mostly matters to stock investors — it doesn't affect your day-to-day life or small business.

stories.title: Brazil launches AI supercomputer push while balancing US and Chinese tech
stories.simple_summary: Brazil is building a very powerful AI computer system while trying to stay balanced between technology from the United States and China.
stories.why_it_matters: This is a story about government and international relations — it has no direct impact on you unless you do business in Brazil.

stories.title: AI data startup Micro1 reaches $500M gross run rate amid AI training boom
stories.simple_summary: A company that provides data for training AI systems is growing very quickly because so many AI projects need massive amounts of information to learn from.
stories.why_it_matters: This matters to investors in AI companies, but doesn't directly affect small business owners or ordinary people.

stories.title: Micron CEO: AI has 'totally changed' the equation for the boom-and-bust memory industry
stories.simple_summary: The leader of Micron (a computer chip company) says AI demand has changed how their business works, making it grow in ways that weren't possible before.
stories.why_it_matters: This is good news for the company's investors, but ordinary people don't need to do anything about it.

stories.title: OpenAI is gaining on Anthropic with business users, new data indicates
stories.simple_summary: OpenAI and Anthropic are two AI companies competing for business customers, and the customers keep switching between them as each releases new versions.
stories.why_it_matters: This matters to investors worried about whether companies will stick with one AI service — it doesn't affect most small businesses yet.

stories.title: ChatGPT can now send texts for you with new Apple Messages plug-in
stories.simple_summary: ChatGPT can now write text messages for you through Apple's Messages app, so the AI writes what you tell it to say.
stories.why_it_matters: If you use an iPhone and Messages, you can now let AI draft texts for you — it's a convenience feature, but you still need to check and approve what it writes.

stories.title: Google Discover is getting an AI chatbot-tuned feed
stories.simple_summary: Google is adding AI to its Discover feed (the personalized news and articles it shows you) so you can describe what topics you want to see, and it learns your preferences.
stories.why_it_matters: If you use Google's app, you may see better personalized content — it's a small convenience improvement with no cost to you.
